51/S0.subgoal: Describe the limitations of the natural walking model and the proposed approach to optimize cyber sickness.

51/S1.subgoal: Explain the factors influencing VR exposure duration and the concept of a semi-interactive tour model.

51/S2.subgoal: Identify two primary approaches for optimizing exposure duration in a virtual tour.

51/S3.subgoal: Formulate the problem of finding a minimum-duration path as a graph-theoretic problem.

51/S4.subgoal: Calculate travel time between directly connected nodes using the natural walking speed model.

51/S5.subgoal: Map the path-finding problem to a Traveling Salesman Problem by introducing hypothetical edges for a complete graph.

51/S6.subgoal: Describe the step-by-step algorithm for computing the optimal path using a TSP solver.

51/S7.subgoal: Summarize the process of optimizing VR navigation through graph formulation and TSP mapping.
